jobs.title: AI Transformation Leader
jobs.description:
Hybrid Role; Travel required



Transform healthcare with us.

At Qualified Health, we’re redefining what’s possible with Generative AI in healthcare. Our infrastructure provides the guardrails for safe AI governance, healthcare-specific agent creation, and real-time algorithm monitoring—working alongside leading health systems to drive real change.

This is more than just a job. It’s an opportunity to build the future of AI in healthcare, solve complex challenges, and make a lasting impact on patient care. If you’re ambitious, innovative, and ready to move fast, we’d love to have you on board.

Join us in shaping the future of healthcare.



Job Summary:

The AI Transformation Leader will play a pivotal role in managing and delivering value to our healthcare clients. This individual will be responsible for overseeing client engagements, ensuring successful project execution, identifying high-potential AI use cases, driving product discovery and developing product requirements together with the product team, and maintaining strong client relationships. AI Transformation Leader will be the primary point of contact for 2-3 key clients, attending all meetings, and coordinating action items between clients and internal teams. Additionally, this person will support the implementation team during the launch phase to maximize client experience and will facilitate the data integration process, understanding various client data environments and internal engineering team requirements to successfully deliver the product.


Key Responsibilities:

 - Serve as the primary liaison between Qualified Health and assigned clients.

 - Develop and manage against Partnership Plan including articulation of business goals, KPI definition and project plans.

 - Lead all client meetings, providing updates, gathering feedback, and ensuring alignment on project goals.

 - Coordinate and execute action items, ensuring timely delivery of project milestones.

 - Perform thorough workflow analysis, identification of critical areas for value creation, assessment of AI fitness, workflow integration approach and change management needs, and provide additional requirements to product teams as necessary.

 - Identify new use cases and create business and product requirements that provide incremental value to the client.

 - Monitor project progress, identify potential issues, and implement creative solutions to deliver client value.

 - Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, understanding their needs and ensuring their satisfaction.

 - Continuously seek opportunities to improve client engagement processes.

 - Facilitate the data integration process in collaboration with engineering, understanding various client data environments and internal engineering team requirements to successfully deliver the product.

 - Collaborate with internal teams, including product development and engineering, to deliver solutions that meet client requirements.

 - Prepare and present regular status reports to clients and internal stakeholders.


Required Qualifications:

 - Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, STEM, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. A Master’s degree is preferred.

 - Required Experience:
   
   - Minimum of 2-5 years of experience in consulting, client engagement, and/or product management.
   
   - Proven track record of successfully managing client relationships and delivering complex projects.

 

Ideal Experience

 - Experience with data integration processes and understanding of various client data environments.

 - Experience working with AI technologies or healthcare IT solutions is highly desirable.


Desirable Skills:

 - Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely.

 - Interpersonal Skills: Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain positive relationships with clients and internal teams.

 - Problem-Solving: Proactive problem-solving abilities, with a focus on finding effective solutions to client challenges.

 - Organizational Skills: Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

 - Adaptability: Flexibility and adaptability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment.

 - Customer Focus: A strong customer-centric mindset, with a commitment to delivering exceptional value to clients.

 - Team Player: Collaborative team player who can work effectively with cross-functional teams to achieve common goals.

 - Self Starter:  Ability to work independently with minimal supervision


Travel Requirements

 - This role requires significant travel to healthcare client sites, often for extended engagements. Candidates should be prepared for up to 20%-40% travel, depending on active projects.


What We Offer:

 - Competitive startup salary and equity packages.

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance.

 - Flexible working hours and hybrid work options.

 - An opportunity to be at the forefront of AI in healthcare, making substantial impacts on patient care and outcomes.

 - A vibrant and inclusive work environment that fosters creativity and innovation. 


Pay & Benefits: The pay range for this role is between $175,000 and $250,000. Compensation will be determined based on level within this job category, as well as your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing
jobs.description:
TRANSFORM HEALTHCARE WITH US.

Qualified Health is the leading healthcare AI company partnering with health systems to deploy end-to-end AI platforms that deliver measurable financial and clinical outcomes. Backed by leading healthcare innovation investors like NEA, Transformation Capital, and SignalFire, we work with some of the most recognized health systems in the country. Not as a vendor, but as a long-term strategic partner.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Every C-suite in healthcare is asking how to make AI real. This role determines whether we win the conversation.

You will own the engine that carries Qualified Health’s story to health system CEOs: you will produce and distribute the content that expresses the company narrative, and turn our flagship customers into proof the market trusts. You will do this in close partnership with our Corporate Strategy team, who set the company’s strategic positions, and our AI Transformation (AIT) team, who work day-to-day inside our customers’ deployments. You will maintain the competitive context that sharpen our sales materials. You will produce the thought leadership and marketing content that establishes Qualified Health as the authority in healthcare AI. And you will support the strategic partnerships that are central to our go-to-market motion.

You will report into Commercial leadership but work cross functionally across the organization. The scope is broad by design. We need someone who can operate across multiple workstreams, move fast, and raise the quality of everything the commercial team puts in front of partners.




OUTCOMES

 - Marketing drives a measurable, predictable share of pipeline and revenue. Qualified Health has a defensible demand engine, with clear targets, a healthy mix of inbound and outbound-supporting motion, and a tight feedback loop with Commercial, and marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline grow as the company does.

 - Qualified Health’s category narrative lands in market. The positioning and point of view, developed with the Strategy team, are expressed clearly and consistently to buyers, press, analysts, and partners through the content and channels this role runs.

 - The brand is recognizable, credible, and chosen. Health system executives, clinicians, and policy-adjacent audiences know who Qualified Health is, what we stand for, and why we’re the team to bet on, reflected in earned media, share of voice, analyst recognition, and inbound interest.

 - Commercial sells with conviction. Sellers, partnerships leaders, product teams, and AI Transformation teams go to market with messaging, materials, competitive intelligence, and customer proof points that reflect deep product understanding and consistently move deals forward.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Marketing Strategy & Operations

 - Set the marketing strategy and operating plan: define the goals, segments, channels, and investments that will move the company’s commercial and category outcomes, and align them with the CEO, Commercial, and Product.

 - Own the marketing budget and resource allocation: make clear, defensible strategic investments on where marketing dollars and headcount go, and report transparently on what they return.

 - Establish the marketing operating system: target accounts, funnel definitions, attribution, dashboards, and the marketing tech tools and lead-generation stack that lets the function run as a highly measurable growth engine.



Product Marketing & Sales Enablement

 - Support go-to-market product launches by driving the messaging, commercial collateral, and sales enablement required to successfully bring new capabilities to market.

 - Develop materials that translate platform capabilities into clear business cases for health system leaders.

 - Build executive-ready deliverables for health system senior leadership teams, board presentations, and C-suite workshops.

 - Maintain the competitive context sales needs in live deals, including battlecards, objection handling, vendor penetration data, and latest partnership announcements.

 - Ensure consistency and quality across all external-facing commercial content.



Brand & Strategic Positioning

 - Analyze market trends, competitor language shifts, and regulatory changes to continually pressure-test and sharpen our unique value proposition and strategic positioning.

 - Develop narratives and positioning frameworks that resonate with health system executives navigating AI adoption.

 - Carry the company’s positioning and messaging, developed with the Strategy team, consistently across the website, collateral, sales conversations, press, and executive communications, so they tell one coherent, differentiated story.

 - Manage the corporate website and digital footprint as a primary strategic surface for positioning, demand generation, and credibility.

 - Steward the Qualified Health brand: own our visual identity, voice, and ensure brand excellence across every external touchpoint.



Communications, Content, & Customer Advocacy

 - Own the earned media strategy and grow our share of voice in tier-one healthcare and technology outlets to actively shape market perception.

 - Manage external communications for major company milestones including funding announcements, product launches, and strategic partnerships.

 - Run a structured analyst relations program with organizations like KLAS, Gartner, and Forrester while aggressively pursuing industry awards and speaking opportunities.

 - Elevate the profile of our founders and senior leaders by developing and managing a comprehensive executive thought leadership program.

 - Run a thought-leadership content engine that positions Qualified Health as the authority in healthcare AI: produce articles, white papers, and webinars distributed across earned and owned channels.

 - Own the customer-proof pipeline: decide which flagship-customer proof points to pursue, work with the AIT and product teams closest to the deployments to produce them, and distribute them as case studies, white papers, and webinars.

 - Translate complex AI and healthcare concepts into clear, compelling content for non-technical executive audiences.



Field Marketing & Strategic Partnerships

 - Set the events and field strategy: which conferences, summits, and hosted events matter, defining clear success metrics for each, and how they ladder back to pipeline and brand goals.

 - Build durable partnerships with leading healthcare organizations, professional societies, and thought leadership platforms, structured to generate co-branded content, shared audiences, and recurring visibility.

 - Partner with the Events Coordinator and Commercial leaders to ensure every executive summit, dinner, and convening reflects Qualified Health’s standards and advances the company’s most important relationships.




YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU

 - Have helped scale healthcare technology companies to $50–$100M+, with marketing work you can tie directly to that growth

 - Have a deep understanding of how health systems work

 - Are deeply familiar with the AI landscape and can credibly speak to how AI creates value in complex organizations. You follow the market closely and can separate signal from noise

 - Are an exceptional writer and communicator who can translate complex ideas into clear, compelling narratives for executive audiences

 - Have a strong ownership mindset: you’re independent, with a bias to action. When you find a problem, you make it yours to fix

 - Can manage multiple high-priority workstreams simultaneously without dropping quality

 - Have experience building commercial or marketing infrastructure from scratch, not just optimizing what already exists

 - Are naturally curious about markets, competitors, and positioning, and can synthesize large amounts of information into clear recommendations

 - Thrive in fast-paced environments where the scope of your role evolves as the company grows




WHY QUALIFIED HEALTH

You’ll shape how America’s largest health systems apply AI to achieve measurable outcomes. Every health system CEO in the country is asking how to make AI real. We’re one of the few companies with a deployed platform, signed partnerships, and demonstrated results.



We have real momentum. We just closed our Series B fundraise supported by incredible investors like Frist Cressey, Healthier Capital, NEA, Transformation Capital, and SignalFire. Our partnerships span some of the most recognized health systems in the country, and our revenue trajectory is ambitious and attainable.

A front-row seat to healthcare’s AI transformation. In a given week, you’ll engage with multiple health system leadership teams, each with different strategic challenges. You’ll work alongside clinical and engineering teams to build the commercial infrastructure for a company defining a new category.

You’ll build, not inherit. We are still early. The commercial infrastructure, the partnership models, the go-to-market playbook. You’ll have a direct hand in building all of it. The people who join now will define how this company operates for years.




ADDITIONAL DETAILS

 - Willingness to travel domestically as required to support partnerships and represent the company at industry events

 - Competitive base salary and equity compensation




OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY

Qualified Health is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is essential to our success, and we are committed to building a team that reflects the world we live in. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, disability, or veteran status.




PAY & BENEFITS

The pay range for this role is between $170,000 and $210,000, and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.
